title: Rankhog
lede: Rankhog watches subreddits for posts asking for products like yours, drafts a reply shaped to each community's rules, and posts it from your own Reddit account after your approval or on autopilot.

points: A radar scans the subreddits your buyers use and flags fresh threads where someone asks for a recommendation.
Each draft follows the subreddit's rules and style and is checked against them before it goes out; the product is named only when it fits.
Replies post from the user's account at a human pace, approved one at a time or sent automatically.
Users without a Reddit account can have a new one built up with helpful comments, and they own it.
It runs from the app or from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other MCP clients.

sections.text: Founders and small teams who want customers from Reddit threads but lack the time to learn each subreddit's rules. Commenters mostly ask how it avoids bans and shadowbans.
The launch comment puts the plan at $99 a month per product with a 7-day free trial, plus a free Reddit audit and free tools such as a shadowban checker.
